Yes, in the latest run. Run-2 (12 Nov 2026) shows all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covering every day from 1 to 8 October 2026. It found no thermal detections intersecting the asset (ASSET-F27) in that period.

The earlier run-1 (8 Oct 2026) was incomplete. All four sensors were covered only through 7 October. The last day, 7–8 October, was marked not covered because it came after the latest near-real-time file update (day in progress or not yet published). That run also found zero detections, but it could not confirm the final day.

The later run closes that gap, so the "no detections" result now holds for the full period. One caveat: the data is near-real-time, so it is not the final processed product.
